links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy versus human consensus reference standard across 29 categories, with error typing
links.effect: Accuracies between 74% (pathology; 95% CI 65% to 82%) and 90% (patient characteristics; 95% CI 87% to 94%); manual extraction showed 29% interobserver disagreement.
links.quote: LLM-powered extraction achieved accuracies between 74% [pathology: 95% confidence interval (CI) 65% to 82%] and 90% (patient characteristics: 95% CI 87% to 94%).

links.outcome: Hallucinations and other error types in LLM-extracted clinical note data
links.effect: Hallucinations rare (0.16%) and low impact; 68 of 2555 extracted values rated high-impact errors, though evaluator ratings varied widely.
links.quote: Of 2555 extracted values, 68 were rated as high-impact errors, although evaluator assessments varied widely.

unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted structured data extraction from clinical notes to reduce documentation time (8.6 to 1.9 minutes per case)

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, error types, and time savings of an LLM for structured data extraction from clinical documentation compared to manual physician extraction without testing a specific deployment practice/safeguard comparison.
